Synopsis:
US VP JD Vance deflected responsibility for a US airstrike that killed four people at a wedding in southern Iran near the Strait of Hormuz. The broader US-Iran military conflict, now in its seventh month with 18 US service members killed, shows no signs of abating. Strikes have targeted Iranian air defense, radar, maritime assets and communications infrastructure. Civilian casualties, including a prior incident at a school killing 156, are drawing international scrutiny. No peace deal is in sight.
